diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
diseases.follow_up_protocol: Check fasting blood sugar daily. Schedule HbA1c test every 3 months. Verify foot inspection weekly.
diseases.first_line_management: Metformin therapy as prescribed, dietary glycemic index management, daily aerobic exercise.

diseases.name: Hypertension (Stage 1 & 2)
emergency_flags: systolic BP > 180 mmHg or diastolic > 120 mmHg
diseases.follow_up_protocol: Monitor seated BP twice daily (morning and evening). Schedule physician review after 14 days of medication initiation.
diseases.first_line_management: Sodium restriction (<2g/day), DASH diet, ACE inhibitors / ARBs as prescribed by physician.

diseases.name: Acute Upper Respiratory Infection
diseases.follow_up_protocol: Automated follow-up on Day 3 and Day 7. Inquire about fever resolution and persistent cough.
diseases.first_line_management: Supportive hydration, paracetamol/ibuprofen for fever, rest. Avoid unnecessary antibiotic prescription.
